prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your original account method to keep your saved pets and progress."}}
1: [home, wait_info] waiting_screen_progress_estimate: Enable time estimates and progress indicators on the waiting screen while the pet is being prepared.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "headline": "Bringing your pet to life..."}}
2: [finish, redesign] home_intro_desktop_visibility_check: Redesign the home intro screen into a full-bleed visual layout emphasizing desktop verification steps.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Your pet is now live on your desktop!", "body": "Check your desktop taskbar and screen to confirm your pet has spawned."}}
3: [choose_path, layout] story_screen_split_layout: Switch the intro story screen to a split layout highlighting companion choices visually.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion"}}
4: [adoption, new_screen] photo_upload_preview_verification: Add a new image verification screen right after photo upload to confirm upload quality before pet creation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Preview your uploaded images to make sure your pet turns out great."}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_photo_check", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
5: [sign_in, reorder] sign_in_after_pick_friend: Reorder sign-in to occur right after pet selection instead of before path choice.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in to save your newly chosen pet companion."}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "sign_in", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
6: [adoption, new_flow] adoption_trait_customization_flow: Insert a trait selection sub-flow during adoption where users select personality traits for their pet.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"hint": "Select your pet's base character before customizing personality traits."}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_pet_traits", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
7: [home, notification] waiting_ready_notification: Enable desktop notification opt-in on the waiting screen so users know when generation is complete.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We'll notify you as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop."}}
8: [finish, hint] home_intro_interaction_tips: Add clear hint text on the home intro screen detailing mouse shortcuts for pet controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to open controls, settings, or chat."}}
9: [choose_path, copy] choose_path_clear_option_descriptions: Update copy on choose_path screen to explicitly distinguish between pre-made pets and custom photo pets.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select How You'd Like to Start", "body": "Choose a ready-made pet companion or create a custom pet from your photos.", "hint": "You can add more pets later."}}
